premises.text: Connected things are proliferating, with 6 billion in use by year end
premises.evidence_span: 6 billion connected things will be in use till the end of this year

premises.text: Checking the phone every minute is a bad way to communicate with technology
premises.evidence_span: There should be a nicer way to communicate with technology rather than checking your phone every single minute

premises.text: Glance Clock pairs a well-designed wall clock with a glanceable display, speaker, and open cloud platform
premises.evidence_span: Glance Clock is a well-designed wall clock with embedded glanceable display, built-in speaker, and open cloud platform

premises.text: Background geometric shapes make information readable at a glance without disruption
premises.evidence_span: It allows you to read information quickly at a glance without being disrupted from your current tasks

premises.text: Open-API integrations connect the clock to wearables, connected devices, and web services

premises.text: The cloud decides what, when, and where to display, always relevant to place and situation
